result.title: Logic-Guided Graph Denoising Diffusion Models
result.summary: Graph diffusion models are competitive approaches for generating complex graph-structured data. However, when such distributions have strict structural constraints, diffusion models may fail to capture them exactly, resulting in the generation of invalid graphs. In this paper, we propose a method for grounding graph diffusion models in domain-specific knowledge via First Order Logic (FOL), leveraging its expressive and interpretable formalism to impose structural constraints on the generative process. We incorporate domain knowledge using classifier guidance, a technique that conditions the diffusion model's distribution on external variables to exert control over the sampled data. During the generative process, classifier guidance steers the denoising trajectory to optimize an objective function, which we define as a fuzzy and differentiable relaxation of the logical rules. Our methodology requires only the specification of constraints in FOL, whose satisfaction is encouraged at inference time to guide a pre-trained generative model. We evaluate our approach by comparing the unconditional generation of knowledge graphs with our logic-guided framework, which incorporates domain ontologies as structural constraints during inference. This approach significantly increases the proportion of generated graphs that satisfy the ontological constraints.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文将一阶逻辑规则作为领域约束注入图扩散模型：把 FOL 规则松弛为模糊可微目标函数，并在推理阶段以 classifier guidance 调整去噪轨迹，从而提升知识图谱生成结果满足本体约束的比例。
AI.relevance_reason: 「冻结预训练生成模型、推理时用可微约束目标引导采样轨迹」这一做法，可能为 LVR 中引导 latent 推理状态满足任务必要约束（如视觉证据筛选与内容保留）提供可核查的方法线索，其梯度形式与状态更新的兼容性需人工确认。
